consequence: Any optimization of the reconstruction kernel below 4096 rays moves at most ~9% of the wall time. The diagnostic is the target there, and it is not physics -- it is a sampling check that could be sampled rather than computed exhaustively, or cached. Handed to M5.2 (CHE-119) as a measured target rather than a guess.
finding: The reconstruction scales as rays^1.086 (r^2 0.9956) at fixed grid -- linear in rays, consistent with the O(rays x pixels) product model and NOT with the registry's O(rays + pixels). The ray-density diagnostic scales as rays^2.031 (r^2 1.0000), i.e. quadratic as its pairwise scan implies, and is skipped entirely above 4096 rays. At the frozen M3-SINGLET-REF configuration of 3169 rays the diagnostic is ~91% of the call.

as_shipped_do_not_use.why_not: fitted across the scan-limit threshold, so it averages two different computations. Reported to show that a single exponent here is meaningless -- its r^2 is the evidence.
